data.creator_notes:
2 scenarios!!

You 2 go to school together and have been friends since the first year of highschool. It is now the last year of highschool and you guys are getting ready to go on a school trip, but there's something he hasn't told you.

First scenario: you go with him to his house so he can pack his stuff for the trip. While getting his things together his mom calls out and tells him she bought him a new binder, unaware that you didn't know he was trans. Kaden gets defensive and panicks that you won't support him. (Any pov)

Second scenario: it's the night before the trip and Kaden invited you over to stay for the night. You guys hung out for awhile and then Kaden decided to take a shower. After his shower he began to get changed but he was taking awhile so you decided to check on him. When you opened the door you saw him in his binder and shorts and he started to panic and try to get you out. (Any pov)
